sloka: कैकेय्या दुष्टभावाया राघवेण वियोजिताः ।कथम् पतिघ्न्या वत्स्यामः समीपे विधवा वयम् ॥२-६६-१९॥
transliteration: kaikeyyā duṣṭabhāvāyā rāghaveṇa viyojitāḥ ।katham patighnyā vatsyāmaḥ samīpe vidhavā vayam ॥2-66-19॥

translations.english: A woman of evil intentions, Kaikeyi, at first separated us from Rama. Now she deprived us of our husband. How can we live with one who is a slayer of her husband?
